assets.rationale: This frame gives the clearest view of the chalkboard keywords while keeping the lecturer's gesture aligned with the phrase "Bank run." The main board text is complete and legible, and the lecturer occludes less of the useful writing than in the other candidates. It is the strongest documentary frame for this lecture moment because it captures the conceptual layout that connects the Diamond-Dybvig model to multiple equilibria and bank runs.
